n.ruleSearch:
{
  "author": ".author@text",
  "bookList": ".library li:lt(5)",
  "bookUrl": ".bookname@href",
  "coverUrl": "a img@src",
  "intro": ".intro@text@js:result.trim()",
  "kind": ".layui-badge@text&&p:contains(作者：)@text@js:result.replace(/作者：[^\\|]+\\||分类：/g, '').replace(/(字数：)?(\\d+[千万]?)字?/, '$2字').replace('|', ',')",
  "lastChapter": ".chapter@text##最新章节：",
  "name": ".bookname@text"
}
